name: @cyclone-ui/onboarding
description: An Onboarding block that walks new users through an application in a few steps. The root tracks the current step (controlled or uncontrolled), gates the Next button with canGoNext and calls onComplete on the last step; Onboarding.Step shows its content only on its step, Onboarding.StepIndicator draws dots or pills, Onboarding.Header shows a centered title and description, and Onboarding.Navigation renders Back and Next/Complete buttons. A step can have sub-steps that Next and Back page through first, such as the items of a FeatureCarousel, a keyboard-navigable list of features that binds to the onboarding's sub-step. TipsList shows numbered tips and useOnboarding reads the state. Use it for first-run setup, product tours and personalization screens.
